title: UG-039 — Match the question style to the data needed
intent: Convert an EUSurvey best-practice recommendation into a practical KB article.
short_answer: Choose question types according to the data you need. Ask one thing per question, use balanced scales, provide answer options, and add text boxes for explanations such as Other.
important_conditions: This recommendation comes from the EUSurvey best-practices guidance.
